evals.name: validates-rendered-option-without-settings-edits
evals.expected_output: Reports the rendered output_dir or the private plugin-data fallback, asks whether reports should remain private or use a portable repository location, and never reads or edits settings files or pluginConfigs.
expectations: Reads only the rendered user_config value supplied to the skill
Explains the private plugin-data fallback when output_dir is unset
Does not inspect or edit settings files or pluginConfigs

evals.name: routes-changes-through-claude-configuration
evals.expected_output: Inspects the repository's declared artifact conventions, recommends a portable location, directs the user to Claude Code's plugin configuration prompt, and requires a rerun before claiming the value changed.
expectations: Uses repository evidence before recommending a destination
Routes persistence through Claude Code and verifies on rerun
